title: Insurance Card Scanning
desc: Photographing an insurance card at check-in and turning it into a clean, structured EHR record in seconds, instead of hand-keying member IDs while the waiting room backs up.

title: Patient Intake Form Digitization
desc: Converting scanned or photographed intake forms into structured EHR fields, extending card scanning to the multi-page, many-field paperwork every new patient fills out.

title: Lab Requisition Form Extraction
desc: Reading faxed lab requisitions (tests ordered, diagnosis codes, provider details) into structured orders, so labs stop re-keying handwriting and chasing missing information.

title: Prior Authorization Document Processing
desc: Extracting the clinical facts a prior-authorization request buries across faxed pages, so reviewers spend their time on the decision rather than hunting for the data.

title: Claims Attachment Processing
desc: Splitting and extracting the multi-document PDF packages that support claims, so an examiner is not paging through 38 scanned sheets to find the one relevant operative note.

title: Handwritten Clinical Note Digitization
desc: Transcribing handwritten clinical notes into searchable text, the hardest OCR case in the chapter, with explicit confidence thresholds for when a human must verify.

title: Prescription Label OCR
desc: Turning a phone photo of a prescription label into a structured medication record, so care coordinators know exactly what a recently discharged patient is taking.

title: Explanation of Benefits Processing
desc: Parsing Explanation of Benefits documents into structured billed, allowed, paid, and owed fields, so members and downstream systems can actually use what the payer sent.

title: Medical Records Request Extraction
desc: Reading faxed medical-records requests to identify exactly which records, dates, and encounters are being asked for, so release-of-information staff can fulfill them without manual triage.

title: Historical Chart Migration
desc: Digitizing warehouses of legacy paper charts at acquisition scale, turning tens of thousands of scanned pages into structured records the EHR can index.

title: Patient Message Response Drafting
desc: Drafting replies to patient portal messages so clinical staff edit and send rather than compose from scratch, taming an inbox patients love and staff dread.

title: Medical Terminology Simplification
desc: Rewriting clinical jargon into plain language a patient can act on, turning 'ST-elevation myocardial infarction, dual antiplatelet therapy' into instructions that make sense at home.

title: Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Suggestions
desc: Flagging where a clinical note is too thin for accurate coding and suggesting the specificity that captures severity, so documentation reflects the care actually delivered.

title: Prior Authorization Letter Generation
desc: Generating grounded prior-authorization letters from the chart and the payer's own criteria, so a fifteen-minute clinical decision stops becoming a four-hour writing project.

title: After-Visit Summary Generation
desc: Producing an after-visit summary a patient will actually read and act on, replacing the EHR's auto-generated boilerplate with a personalized, plain-language recap.

title: Clinical Note Summarization
desc: Summarizing a patient's sprawling chart into the few facts a covering clinician needs at 6:45 AM, instead of reading forty notes per patient across an unfamiliar service.

title: Literature Search and Evidence Synthesis
desc: Pulling and synthesizing the relevant literature for a specific clinical question at the point of care, so evidence arrives during the visit rather than days later.

title: Ambient Clinical Documentation
desc: Turning the ambient conversation of a visit into a draft clinical note, so physicians stop finishing eleven charts in the parking lot after the last patient leaves.

title: Clinical Decision Support Synthesis
desc: Synthesizing a complex patient's full picture into decision support at the bedside, so a clinician managing competing conditions at 2 AM sees the interactions and contraindications at once.

title: Multi-Modal Clinical Reasoning
desc: Reasoning across notes, labs, and imaging together rather than in isolation, so an ED workup of a complex patient integrates every signal instead of one modality at a time.

title: Duplicate Claim Detection
desc: Catching duplicate and near-duplicate claims before they pay, recovering the 1 to 3 percent of paid claims that quietly leak out as duplicate payments each month.

title: Patient No-Show Pattern Detection
desc: Predicting which of tomorrow's appointments will no-show so schedulers can overbook, backfill, or reach out, instead of discovering the empty slots as they happen.

title: Billing Code Anomalies
desc: Surfacing billing patterns that should not exist, such as implausible code combinations and outlier frequencies, so payment-integrity teams catch problems the week they happen rather than in a year-end audit.

title: Medication Dispensing Anomalies
desc: Flagging dispensing orders that fall outside safe patterns of dose, frequency, and weight in real time, so an overnight pharmacist catches the dangerous one in a queue of forty-three.

title: Lab Result Outlier Detection
desc: Distinguishing genuinely critical or implausible lab values from expected variation, so the result that needs action now is surfaced rather than lost in the routine queue.

title: Healthcare Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Detection
desc: Detecting fraud, waste, and abuse as network patterns across providers and claims, surfacing the colluding-clinic rings that a single-claim check would never connect.

title: Patient Deterioration Early Warning
desc: Catching the early physiologic signs that a ward patient is deteriorating, so a stretched night charge nurse is alerted before the patient crashes rather than after.

title: Readmission Risk Anomaly Detection
desc: Spotting the patients whose trajectory signals a likely readmission, so discharge planning and follow-up target the ones most at risk of bouncing back.

title: Cybersecurity / Access Pattern Anomalies
desc: Detecting anomalous EHR access such as snooping and credential misuse from usage patterns, so privacy violations surface instead of waiting for a patient complaint.

title: Epidemic / Outbreak Detection
desc: Detecting disease clusters and emerging outbreaks from routine encounter data, connecting the same-school fever cases that individual clinicians each write off as the flu going around.

title: Appointment Reminder Channel Optimization
desc: Choosing the reminder channel and timing each patient actually responds to, cutting no-shows by reaching people the way they will actually notice.

title: Patient Education Content Matching
desc: Matching each patient to education content at the right reading level and language, so a new diagnosis is backed by material that fits rather than a generic handout.

title: Provider Directory Search Optimization
desc: Ranking a health plan's Find a Doctor results by who is actually in-network, accepting patients, and correctly classified, rather than nearest-first, so members stop giving up at result twelve.

title: Wellness Program Recommendations
desc: Matching members to the wellness programs they are most likely to enroll in and complete, so a self-insured employer's cessation and prevention offerings reach the right people.

title: Medication Adherence Intervention Targeting
desc: Identifying which patients are about to lapse on their medications and which nudge will help, so adherence outreach targets the people and moments that matter.

title: Care Gap Prioritization
desc: Prioritizing which open care gaps to close first for each patient, so outreach starts with the gaps that most affect outcomes rather than a flat checklist.

title: Care Management Program Enrollment
desc: Identifying the complex, rising-risk patients who would benefit most from care management, so limited care-manager capacity goes where it can help most.

title: Treatment Response Prediction
desc: Predicting how a given patient is likely to respond to treatment options, so the next therapy is chosen on likely benefit rather than trial and error.

title: Personalized Care Plan Generation
desc: Generating an individualized, guideline-grounded care plan for a multimorbid patient, reconciling diabetes, heart failure, kidney disease, and depression into one coherent plan.

title: Dynamic Treatment Regime Recommendation
desc: Recommending how a treatment regimen should adapt over time as a chronic patient's conditions evolve, rather than fixing a single plan at one visit.

title: Internal Duplicate Patient Detection
desc: Finding the same patient duplicated under multiple records within one system, so a common name resolves to a single chart instead of several fragmented ones.

title: Provider NPI Matching
desc: Matching and de-duplicating provider records across systems and NPIs, so a plan's directory reflects who is actually practicing where, not who was two years ago.

title: Address Standardization and Household Linkage
desc: Standardizing messy address fields and linking patients into households, so outreach, geocoding, and duplicate detection all work off consistent, comparable locations.

title: Insurance Eligibility Matching
desc: Matching a patient to the correct active coverage at check-in, so eligibility verification returns the right plan instead of a mismatch that surfaces later as a denial.

title: Cross-Facility Patient Matching (HIE)
desc: Matching a patient to their records across facilities in a health information exchange, so a trauma team can learn in seconds whether an unconscious patient is on blood thinners.

title: Claims-to-Clinical Data Linkage
desc: Linking a patient's claims and clinical records, so analysts can answer outcome questions like readmissions, cost, and quality that neither dataset can answer alone.

title: Longitudinal Patient Matching Across Name Changes
desc: Keeping a patient's record linked across name changes over time, so a marriage or legal name change does not fracture their history into two separate charts.

title: Privacy-Preserving Record Linkage
desc: Linking records across organizations without either side exposing raw identifiers, so a payer and an academic center can study a shared population while protecting PII.

title: National-Scale Patient Matching (TEFCA)
desc: Matching patients at national scale across the TEFCA networks, so records follow a person between unaffiliated systems even in an emergency far from home.

title: Deceased Patient Resolution and Record Reconciliation
desc: Detecting and reconciling deceased-patient records across sources, so a health system stops sending appointment reminders to someone who died months ago.

title: Geographic Patient Clustering
desc: Clustering a patient population by geography to guide decisions like where to open the next clinic, using where people live and which sites they already use.

title: Utilization Pattern Segmentation
desc: Segmenting a population by how it actually uses care, so population-health outreach fits distinct utilization patterns instead of treating everyone the same.

title: Payer Mix Financial Risk Clustering
desc: Clustering the book of business by payer mix and financial risk, so a CFO can see the quiet shifts eroding revenue before they show up as a shortfall.

title: Disease Severity Stratification
desc: Stratifying a large chronic-disease population by severity, so limited care-management capacity goes to the patients who need it most rather than first-come-first-served.

title: Provider Practice Pattern Analysis
desc: Clustering providers by practice pattern to surface unwarranted variation, such as a threefold spread in MRI ordering among peers treating similar patients.

title: Patient Similarity for Care Planning
desc: Finding the patients most similar to the one in front of you, so a care plan can draw on what actually worked for people like them.

title: Clinical Trial Patient Matching
desc: Matching patients against complex clinical-trial inclusion and exclusion criteria, so recruiters find eligible candidates without hand-screening thousands of charts.

title: Disease Subtype Discovery
desc: Discovering clinically meaningful subtypes within a single diagnosis, so a broad label like heart failure resolves into groups that respond and progress differently.

title: Social Determinant Phenotyping
desc: Phenotyping patients by social determinants, so a care team can see the housing, food, or transport barrier that explains why clinical adjustments alone never stick.

title: Multi-Morbidity Pattern Discovery
desc: Discovering common multi-morbidity patterns among the highest-need patients, so care is organized around real combinations of conditions rather than one disease program at a time.

title: Appointment No-Show Prediction
desc: Scoring each upcoming appointment for its no-show probability, so overbooking and reminders are targeted by risk rather than applied blindly across a 5 to 30 percent no-show rate.

title: Propensity to Pay Scoring
desc: Scoring patient balances by likelihood of payment, so revenue-cycle teams tailor their approach instead of chasing a retiree's copay the same way as a large surgical balance.

title: Patient Churn / Disenrollment Prediction
desc: Predicting which members are likely to disenroll, so retention outreach reaches them before open enrollment closes and the book shrinks.

title: ED Visit Prediction
desc: Predicting which patients are heading for an avoidable ED visit, so care teams can redirect them to primary or urgent care before the visit happens.

title: 30-Day Readmission Risk
desc: Scoring a patient's 30-day readmission risk at discharge, so follow-up and support concentrate on the ones most likely to bounce back.

title: Rising Risk Identification
desc: Identifying the rising-risk patients trending toward high cost and complexity, so intervention starts before they join the sickest 5 percent, not after.

title: Length of Stay Prediction
desc: Predicting expected length of stay at admission, so bed management and discharge planning start on day one instead of guessing on day three.

title: Disease Progression Modeling
desc: Modeling how a chronic disease is likely to progress for a given patient, so a declining trajectory informs when to escalate before a crisis.

title: Mortality Risk Scoring (ICU)
desc: Scoring ICU mortality risk from the evolving clinical picture, so prognosis conversations and resource decisions rest on more than gestalt.

title: Optimal Intervention Timing Prediction
desc: Predicting the moment an intervention will do the most good for each patient, so scarce care-manager touches land when they will change the trajectory.

title: Claim Denial and Prior-Auth Determination Prediction
desc: Predicting which claims will be denied and which prior-auths refused before submission, so teams fix or pre-empt them instead of reworking after the fact.

title: Cohort Matching and Case-Based Reasoning for Novel Claims
desc: Handling novel claims a trained model has no history for by reasoning from the most similar past cases, so sparse payer-procedure combinations still get a defensible determination.

title: Chief Complaint Classification
desc: Classifying free-text chief complaints into consistent categories, so 'my chest hurts', 'chest pain', and 'cp' all map to the same triage concept.

title: Patient Sentiment Analysis
desc: Analyzing the sentiment and themes in patient feedback at scale, so tens of thousands of monthly comments, reviews, and messages become an actionable signal rather than a backlog.

title: ICD-10 Code Suggestion
desc: Suggesting ICD-10 codes from the clinical note, so a coder confirms and refines rather than assigning every diagnosis by hand across a full daily queue.

title: Medication Extraction and Normalization
desc: Extracting medications from notes and transfer summaries and normalizing them to standard terms, so a reconciled list emerges from vague descriptions and conflicting sources.

title: Problem List Extraction
desc: Extracting an accurate problem list from the notes, so the one place a clinician glances for active conditions is complete and current rather than stale.

title: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Extraction
desc: Extracting social determinants documented in free text, so the housing, food, and transport barriers driving poor outcomes become visible and addressable.

title: Adverse Event Detection in Clinical Text
desc: Mining clinical notes for adverse-drug-reaction mentions that voluntary reporting misses, so safety signals reach pharmacovigilance instead of sitting buried in progress notes.

title: Clinical Assertion Classification
desc: Classifying whether a mentioned condition is present, denied, hypothetical, or about a family member, so 'denies chest pain' is never mistaken for a positive finding.

title: Temporal Relationship Extraction
desc: Extracting the timeline of clinical events from a note, so a system knows what happened when rather than treating every mentioned date as unordered.

title: Phenotype Extraction for Research
desc: Assembling research cohorts by extracting complex phenotypes from records, so a study's multi-criteria definition is applied consistently across thousands of charts.

title: Image Quality Assessment
desc: Flagging non-diagnostic image quality at acquisition, so a blurred or mispositioned study is repeated while the patient is still there, not discovered at read time.

title: Patient Photo Verification
desc: Verifying a patient's identity from a photo at check-in, so a shared or borrowed insurance card is caught before care is billed to the wrong member.

title: Wound Photography Measurement
desc: Measuring wounds from a photo instead of a disposable ruler, so pressure-ulcer dimensions are documented consistently and tracked reliably over time.

title: Dermatology Lesion Triage
desc: Triaging skin lesions from smartphone photos, so limited dermatology capacity is steered toward the concerning cases first when a visit is weeks away.

title: Chest X-Ray Triage
desc: Triaging chest X-rays so time-critical findings like a tension pneumothorax jump the first-in-first-out queue and reach a radiologist before the patient deteriorates.

title: Diabetic Retinopathy Screening
desc: Screening for diabetic retinopathy from retinal images at the point of care, so more of the 37 million people with diabetes get checked than today's roughly 60 percent.

title: Radiology AI Triage (Multi-Modality)
desc: Prioritizing a radiologist's mixed worklist across modalities by urgency, so the study that needs reading now is not stuck behind whatever the scanner finished first.

title: Pathology Slide Analysis
desc: Assisting pathology slide review to flag and quantify findings, so a pathologist's read of tissue for cancer is faster and more consistent.

title: Surgical Video Analysis
desc: Analyzing surgical video for steps, instruments, and events, so recorded procedures become a source of quality review and training instead of a file nobody opens.

title: Multi-Modal Imaging Fusion and Analysis
desc: Fusing multiple imaging modalities into one analysis, so a radiation-oncology plan sees soft-tissue boundaries and metabolic activity together rather than side by side.

title: IVR Call Routing Enhancement
desc: Routing inbound patient calls by understanding why they are calling, so an anticoagulant-refill emergency reaches the right person instead of dead-ending in a phone tree.

title: Voicemail Transcription and Classification
desc: Transcribing and triaging clinical voicemail, so a weekend's worth of messages arrives Monday already sorted by urgency rather than as an undifferentiated queue.

title: Voice-to-Text for EHR Navigation
desc: Driving EHR navigation and entry by voice during the visit, so a clinician can keep eyes on the patient instead of clicking through screens.

title: Medical Transcription (Dictation)
desc: Converting physician dictation into structured clinical text, so notes get finished by voice rather than by typing late into the evening.

title: Patient-Facing Voice Assistant
desc: Giving patients a voice assistant for routine questions like appointments and instructions, so an older patient gets an answer without navigating an app.

title: Speech-to-Text for Telehealth Documentation
desc: Documenting telehealth visits from the two-sided call audio, the more controlled cousin of in-room ambient documentation, so the note is drafted from the conversation.

title: Ambient Clinical Documentation
desc: Capturing multi-speaker in-room visit audio and turning it into a faithful draft note, the speech-and-diarization half of ambient documentation.

title: Voice Biomarker Detection
desc: Detecting health signals in the acoustic properties of a patient's voice, so a short speech sample can flag conditions that show up in how someone speaks.

title: Speech Therapy Assessment and Monitoring
desc: Assessing and tracking speech-therapy progress from recorded speech, so articulation errors are measured consistently between sessions rather than by ear alone.

title: Multilingual Real-Time Medical Interpretation
desc: Interpreting between patient and clinician in real time across languages, so a limited-English patient in the ED is understood without waiting for a human interpreter.

title: FAQ Chatbot
desc: Answering routine patient questions about hours, location, prep, and policies conversationally, so simple questions resolve instantly instead of tying up the front desk.

title: Appointment Scheduling Bot
desc: Letting patients book and reschedule appointments in natural conversation, so a follow-up gets scheduled at 7 PM instead of waiting for office hours and a phone call.

title: Prescription Refill Request Bot
desc: Handling prescription refill requests conversationally, so a patient on several medications can reorder without a phone-tag loop with the office.

title: Pre-Visit Intake Bot
desc: Collecting structured pre-visit intake through conversation, so a patient's history and symptoms are gathered and organized before they arrive.

title: Insurance Benefits Navigator
desc: Explaining coverage, benefits, and costs conversationally, so a member trying to understand an MRI bill gets a plain answer instead of a benefits document.

title: Symptom Checker / Triage Bot
desc: Guiding a patient through symptom triage and steering them to the right level of care, with conservative escalation so a 2 AM chest-pressure case is never under-triaged.

title: Chronic Disease Management Coach
desc: Coaching patients through chronic-disease self-management between visits, so daily decisions about diet, activity, and medications get support rather than a quarterly reset.

title: Mental Health Support Bot
desc: Providing conversational mental-health support with careful crisis escalation, so someone struggling at midnight gets a response and a path to help rather than silence.

title: Care Coordination Assistant
desc: Coordinating the moving parts of a complex patient's care, so appointments, referrals, and follow-ups across many providers are tracked instead of falling through the gaps.

title: Clinical Trial Recruitment Conversationalist
desc: Engaging patients about relevant clinical trials in conversation, so eligible candidates learn about and pre-screen for studies without a manual outreach campaign.

title: Appointment Volume Forecasting
desc: Forecasting appointment and visit volume, so staffing and rooms are matched to demand instead of discovered as an overwhelmed Tuesday morning.

title: Supply Inventory Forecasting
desc: Forecasting clinical supply consumption, so the OR does not discover it is out of a specific staple cartridge the day before the case needs it.

title: ED Arrival Forecasting
desc: Forecasting emergency-department arrivals by time, so staffing is set ahead of the surge rather than pulled from the floor once the waiting room fills.

title: Lab Result Trend Analysis
desc: Turning a patient's years of repeated lab results into trends, so a slow drift in kidney function reads as a trajectory rather than a string of isolated values.

title: Hospital Census Forecasting
desc: Forecasting hour-by-hour, unit-by-unit bed occupancy with prediction intervals, so the bed huddle can act on tonight's likely gridlock instead of a midnight snapshot.

title: Revenue Cycle Cash Flow Forecasting
desc: Forecasting revenue-cycle cash flow, so a CFO sees the effect of payer delays on cash position ahead of time rather than in last week's stale report.

title: Vital Sign Trajectory Monitoring
desc: Watching the trajectory of vital signs rather than fixed thresholds, so a steady creep that never trips an alarm is caught before it becomes a crisis.

title: Disease Progression Trajectory Modeling
desc: Modeling a chronic disease's trajectory from a patient's longitudinal measurements, so care can project decline and time interventions from the trend.

title: Epidemic Forecasting
desc: Forecasting the trajectory of an emerging outbreak from surveillance signals, so public-health action can precede the peak rather than react to it.

title: Physiological Waveform Analysis
desc: Analyzing continuous ICU waveforms such as ECG, arterial pressure, and plethysmography for patterns, so high-frequency signals become early warnings rather than scrolling noise.

title: Drug Formulary Navigation
desc: Navigating a plan's formulary to surface covered, lower-tier therapeutic equivalents, so a prescriber can spare the patient a needless higher-tier cost.

title: Provider Directory as Knowledge Graph
desc: Modeling the provider directory as a knowledge graph, so specialties, locations, affiliations, and acceptance status connect into answers instead of a stale flat list.

title: ICD/CPT Hierarchy Navigation
desc: Navigating the ICD and CPT hierarchies to find the right code, so a coder lands on the precise diagnosis rather than guessing among sibling codes.

title: Drug-Drug Interaction Knowledge Base
desc: Modeling drug interactions as a mechanism-aware knowledge graph, so the system can infer and prioritize real interactions instead of burying clinicians in low-value alerts.

title: Clinical Pathway / Protocol Modeling
desc: Lifting clinical pathways out of 14-page PDFs into a queryable model, so the system can tell whether a patient is on-pathway, flag deviations, and surface the next step when a lab result lands.

title: Care Gap Reasoning Engine
desc: Reasoning over a patient's record and guidelines to surface open care gaps, so overdue tests, exams, and therapies are identified with the logic behind each.

title: Disease-Gene-Drug Relationship Graph
desc: Connecting diseases, genes, and drugs in one graph, so a pharmacogenomic mismatch like a CYP2D6 poor metabolizer on tamoxifen can be reasoned about rather than missed.

title: Medical Concept Normalization and Mapping
desc: Mapping clinical concepts across vocabularies like ICD-10, SNOMED, and HEDIS, so data from an acquired practice lines up with the systems that must consume it.

title: Literature-Derived Knowledge Graph
desc: Building a knowledge graph from the biomedical literature, so findings buried across more than a million new articles a year become connected and queryable.

title: Federated Clinical Knowledge Network
desc: Federating clinical knowledge across institutions, so what one hospital knows about a rare condition is available to another when a patient moves between them.

title: Appointment Slot Optimization
desc: Optimizing appointment templates and slot lengths to the real visit mix, so a complex follow-up and a quick recheck no longer share the same rigid 30-minute box.

title: Patient-Provider Assignment
desc: Reassigning patients to providers optimally, so a departing physician's panel of 1,800 is redistributed by fit and capacity rather than at random.

title: Inventory Reorder Optimization
desc: Optimizing reorder points and quantities for clinical supplies, so stock levels replace the taped-up 'reorder when down to 2 boxes' guesswork.

title: Nurse Staffing Optimization
desc: Building nurse schedules as a constraint-optimization problem, so union rules, certifications, fairness, and coverage are satisfied at once instead of wrestled in a spreadsheet.

title: Operating Room Block Scheduling
desc: Allocating OR block time to services by demand and utilization, so blocks stop sitting empty for one team while another bumps cases to the afternoon.

title: Patient Flow and Bed Assignment
desc: Optimizing bed assignment and patient flow, so admitted patients move to the right unit promptly instead of boarding while beds clear slowly.

title: OR Case Sequencing
desc: Sequencing the day's surgical cases across rooms, so competing constraints and preferences resolve into a schedule that keeps rooms flowing and recovery on time.

title: Ambulance Routing and Dispatch
desc: Optimizing ambulance dispatch and routing, so the unit sent to a 911 call is the one that gets the right care there fastest, not just the nearest on a map.

title: Chemotherapy Scheduling
desc: Scheduling infusion appointments against chairs, nurse monitoring, and regimen timing, so a busy center avoids colliding its six-hour and pre-medication-heavy cases.

title: Health System Network Design
desc: Optimizing where to place, expand, or close facilities across a network, so a multi-year capital budget is allocated against access and demand rather than intuition.

title: Alert Threshold Optimization
desc: Tuning alarm and alert thresholds to cut the flood, so the 150 to 400 alerts a patient generates daily give way to the few that actually warrant attention.

title: Notification Timing Optimization
desc: Learning when to send each patient notification for the best response, so refill, education, and screening outreach lifts off single-digit engagement rates.

title: Clinical Trial Adaptive Randomization
desc: Adapting trial randomization as evidence accrues, so fewer patients are assigned to an arm that already looks inferior while preserving statistical validity.

title: Sepsis Treatment Optimization
desc: Learning sequential sepsis treatment policies for fluids, vasopressors, and timing from historical ICU data to augment clinicians, with honest attention to off-policy-evaluation limits.

title: Ventilator Weaning Protocols
desc: Learning when and how to wean a patient off mechanical ventilation, so extubation timing is guided by the evolving picture rather than a fixed protocol or gestalt.

title: Glucose Control in ICU
desc: Optimizing ICU glucose control as a sequential decision, so insulin dosing adapts to the patient's trajectory instead of a static wall-taped sliding scale.

title: Chronic Disease Treatment Personalization
desc: Personalizing chronic-disease treatment choices over time, so the next agent for a patient with rising A1c is chosen for their profile rather than a one-size ladder.

title: Chemotherapy Dose Optimization
desc: Optimizing chemotherapy dosing across cycles, so decisions to hold, reduce, or proceed weigh toxicity and response rather than defaulting to the protocol dose.

title: Radiation Therapy Adaptive Planning
desc: Adapting radiation plans as a patient's anatomy changes through treatment, so the plan made on day one does not quietly become wrong by day fifteen.

title: Hospital Resource Allocation Under Uncertainty
desc: Allocating scarce hospital resources under uncertainty, so a capacity crunch of full ICU, incoming trauma, and long OR cases is managed with a policy rather than reflex.
